services.name: HGV Category C1 training
services.definition: Category C1 is the licence for driving medium-sized rigid vehicles between 3.5 and 7.5 tonnes.
services.summary: Practical training toward the Category C1 licence (medium-sized vehicles, 3.5t to 7.5t).

services.name: HGV Category C training
services.definition: Category C is the licence for driving a large rigid lorry over 3.5 tonnes.
services.summary: Practical training toward the Category C (rigid lorry, over 3.5t) licence, including off-road and on-road tuition.

services.name: HGV Category C+E training
services.definition: Category C+E is the licence for driving an articulated lorry — a Category C rigid vehicle plus a trailer — and it builds on an existing Category C licence.
services.summary: Practical training toward the Category C+E (articulated lorry) licence for drivers who already hold Category C.

services.name: Category B+E (car and trailer) training
services.definition: Category B+E is the licence that lets you tow a larger trailer, caravan or horsebox behind a car than your standard car licence alone allows.
services.summary: Training toward the Category B+E licence for towing a larger trailer, caravan or horsebox behind a car.

services.name: Driver CPC periodic training
services.definition: Driver CPC is a qualification that keeps a professional driver's licence valid — it means completing 35 hours of training every 5 years.
services.summary: Classroom Driver CPC periodic training (the 35 hours professional drivers renew every 5 years).

services.name: ADR (dangerous goods) training
services.definition: ADR is the certification required to legally transport dangerous goods by road.
services.summary: ADR training for drivers carrying dangerous goods, covering core and relevant class modules.

services.name: Forklift truck training
services.definition: Forklift operator training qualifies you to safely operate a forklift in a workplace or warehouse setting.
services.summary: Forklift truck operator training for workplace/warehouse handling (e.g. counterbalance and reach truck).

services.name: Driver medical (D4)
services.definition: A D4 medical is the medical assessment the DVLA requires to confirm you're fit to hold an HGV or PCV licence.
services.summary: D4 driver medical assessment required for HGV/PCV licence applications and renewals.

services.name: Operator Licence Awareness Training (OLAT)
services.definition: OLAT is training that covers the responsibilities involved in obtaining and maintaining a commercial vehicle operator's licence.
services.summary: One-day and two-day OLAT courses for operators, transport managers and transport staff needing operator-licence compliance knowledge, or refresher/remedial training — delivered classroom, online or nationwide at client premises.
